scope: Prescribed released-derivative behavioral reconstruction; not whole-paper or original randomized p-value reproduction.

data.name: behavioralData_allsubs.csv
data.missingness_policy: Record counts; no participant-condition cell may be empty; no cohort deletion.

conditions.excluded: No TMS on day4 or5, by the declared seven figure predicates only.

participant_cells.valid_trials: Number of finite nonmissing outcome values in that participant-condition cell.
participant_cells.missing_trials: Number of explicit missing outcome values in that cell.

paired_summary.difference: condition a minus b, using corresponding absolute or signed participant means
paired_summary.degenerate: null for positive SD; all_zero if zero SD and zero mean; constant_nonzero otherwise

sign_patterns.assumption: joint sign exchangeability of paired differences

bootstrap.seed_reset: Create a new random.Random(seed) for each contrast and outcome.
bootstrap.index_generation: For each draw, call rng.randrange(15) exactly15 times in row order, then compute fsum(sample)/15.
bootstrap.quantile_type7: Sort all2000 means; position=(1999)*p; interpolate linearly between floor(position) and the next element.
bootstrap.normative_runtime: CPython3.11.6 stdlib Random/randrange, math.fsum/ulp/sqrt; candidate runtime independently checks invented conventions.

holm.families: One family of all six contrasts within each outcome; three families.
holm.adjusted: At rank r starting0: max(previous_adjusted,min(1,(6-r)*p)); initial previous0.

leave_one_person_out.order: The declared roster order in each contrast.
leave_one_person_out.computation: For each omitted participant, recompute paired_summary on the remaining14 figure differences; do not refit or rebootstrap.

comparison.whole_component_agreement: Binary1 only if all required component comparisons agree; all components remain reported.

scientific_limits: Helper formulas are applied to figure predicates; the original helper pipeline has different ispro/anti and grouping conventions.
Corrected inference is a benchmark-specified analysis, not recovery of unpublished random state.
Sign exchangeability and approximate n15 bootstrap assumptions remain.
Cross-day/session contrasts are not automatically randomized causal comparisons.
Public paper/data/code can have appeared in training.
No full paired EEG or whole-paper qualification.
